Privacy Choices

NovelHaven has installed the Google AdSense publisher code for site verification and review. Ads may not be served until Google approves and activates the site. These controls cover NovelHaven reading data stored in your browser.

Advertising status

Under review setup Google AdSense publisher code is installed for site verification and review. Ads may not be served until Google approves and activates the site.

Local reading data

NovelHaven may store bookmarks, reading progress, reader preferences, history, notification state, and related settings in your browser so the site can remember where you left off.

Signed-in data

If you sign in with Google, some supported library information may be synchronized through Firebase. Clearing browser storage does not necessarily delete data already saved to a signed-in cloud account.

Future advertising consent

If AdSense is activated, NovelHaven will use a Google-certified consent management solution where Google requires one. This page will then link to the active ad privacy controls.
